name: site-shot
description: Website screenshot API for Cursor: capture public web pages as PNG, JPEG or WebP in real Chromium, full page or viewport, with automatic ad and cookie-banner removal and country proxies on paid plans. Needs a Site-Shot API key in SITESHOT_API_KEY (get it at https://www.site-shot.com/start/): a confirmed account's key comes with the free plan, 100 API captures a month, no card needed; free-plan captures come from the default location or the US, other countries need a paid plan.
